title: Picking a different status changes nothing until Save
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Click the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with Active selected under Part Status.

Step 2:

  • Inactive is selected and nothing else happens: no confirmation window opens and the title row pill still reads "Active".

Step 3:

  • The window closes without asking anything, and part A is still listed on the Active tab.

Step 4:

  • Part Status shows Active: the pick was not saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R21: “Picking a different status changes nothing until Save. When Save is pressed with a different status picked, the confirmation of Story 10 opens first.”
  • Key Decisions: “The part dialog sets the status, and Save applies it. Part Status is a choice in the form. Picking Active or Inactive changes nothing until Save, and Save asks for confirmation first, the same confirmation the list uses.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
